svg.aria-label: Left: a linear model on raw age draws a straight line through a U-shaped claim cost, quantile bins give a staircase, and a spline basis gives a smooth curve. Right: hours placed on a circle with sine and cosine, so 23:00 and 1:00 are close neighbours
